name: spend
description: One ledger of what agents, sessions and memory spend, per provider and per day (UTC), and a daily cap per provider. At the cap the spending thread pauses with one line and a raise-it action; nothing asks on each call.

settings.label: Daily spend cap across every provider (USD)
settings.help: Everything on every provider together, including any without a setting of its own, each UTC day. At the cap the spending thread pauses on whichever provider. Empty means no cap.

settings.label: Daily spend cap for Claude (USD)
settings.help: Everything on Claude together, each UTC day. At the cap the spending thread pauses and memory answers from facts and search. Empty means no cap.

settings.label: Daily spend cap for Codex (USD)
settings.help: Everything on Codex together, each UTC day. Empty means no cap.

settings.label: Daily spend cap for Gemini (USD)
settings.help: Everything on Gemini together, each UTC day. Empty means no cap.

settings.label: Daily spend cap for Grok (USD)
settings.help: Everything on Grok together, each UTC day. Empty means no cap.

settings.label: Daily spend cap for any other provider (USD)
settings.help: A cap for each provider that has no setting of its own (OpenRouter, say), each UTC day. Empty means no cap.

settings.label: Daily spend cap for Kimi (USD)
settings.help: Everything on Kimi together, each UTC day. Empty means no cap.
